mapper.select: SELECT ROLE_ID FROM SYS_ROLE T WHERE 1=1

SELECT T.ROLE_ID, T.ROLE_NAME, T.REMARK, T.DELEGABLE, T.CREATE_USER_ID, T.CREATE_USER_ORG_NO, T.CREATE_TIME FROM SYS_ROLE T WHERE T.DIRECT_USER_ID IS NULL AND T.ROLE_ID <> 'cc-job-system'
AND T.DELEGABLE=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYS_ROLE_ORG O WHERE O.ROLE_ID=T.ROLE_ID) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SYS_ROLE_ORG O WHERE O.ROLE_ID=T.ROLE_ID AND O.ORG_NO NOT IN #{org})
AND 1=0
AND T.ROLE_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.roleName}, '%')
